reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin that monitors model-account balances through supported provider APIs and presents them in a configurable, auto-refreshing floating panel.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中通过支持的服务商余额接口监控模型账户余额，并以可配置的自动刷新的悬浮窗展示。
summaries.en: Monitors model-account balances through supported provider APIs and displays them in a configurable, auto-refreshing floating panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

capabilities: periodically queries configured model-provider balance APIs
stores plugin settings and API-key configuration locally
provides host-side routes for settings and balance queries
displays and refreshes balance information in a floating web interface
